title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-69p2: ACK from_bytes OOB access on 2-byte input
description:
`Ack::from_bytes_for()` at line ~265 accesses `data[2]` before verifying the slice has at least 3 elements. The only bounds check is `data.len() < 2`, so passing exactly 2 bytes will panic instead of returning `Err`.

This is accessible via both `Ack::from_bytes()` and `Ack::from_bytes_for()` (line 256-258 delegates to `from_bytes_for`). The fuzzer `fuzz_fragment.rs` calls `Ack::from_bytes(data)` which could hit this.

Fix: add a `data.len() < 3` check before accessing `data[2]`.

Affected file: `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` line 265.
